 Recusal
 In order to avoid any opportunity to provide preferential treatment or improperly further the private interests of Barrick Gold Corp., I recused myself from responding to or taking any action regarding an email I received on August 28, 2016, as well as follow-up messages dated September 13 and 22, 2016, sent on behalf of Peter Munk, Chairman of Barrick Gold Corp.
In accordance with the terms of my conflict of interest screen, each of these communications was forwarded to the administrator of my screen and to the Office of the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner.
